# Contributing to Political Ascent

This file is the GitHub-facing pointer. The full contributor handbook lives
in the wiki and the in-repo guide.

## Start here

- **Wiki:** [Contributing](../docs/wiki/Contributing.md) — branch model,
  PR shape, code standards.
- **Full guide:** [`docs/guides/CONTRIBUTING.md`](../docs/guides/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- **Project board:** [Political Ascent — Project 9](https://github.com/users/ScottyVenable/projects/9).
- **Roadmap:** [`docs/wiki/Roadmap.md`](../docs/wiki/Roadmap.md).

## Filing work

- 🐞 **Bugs** → [`bug.yml`](./ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug.yml).
- 💡 **Features** → [`feature.yml`](./ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature.yml).
- 🧱 **Tasks / chores** → [`task.yml`](./ISSUE_TEMPLATE/task.yml).
- 📚 **Docs / wiki** → [`docs.yml`](./ISSUE_TEMPLATE/docs.yml) if it exists,
  otherwise `task.yml` with the `area:docs` label.
- 💬 **Open-ended discussion** → use [Discussions](../../discussions), not
  Issues. See [`.github/discussions-setup.md`](./discussions-setup.md) for
  category guidance.

## Pull requests

- Target `experimental` first. See the wiki Contributing page for the
  full branch promotion path.
- One issue per PR. Link the issue in the PR description.
- Update tests and docs in the same PR.
- Fill out [`PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`](./PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md).

## Code of Conduct

By participating you agree to the
[Code of Conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) (Contributor Covenant 2.1).
